fixtures.result: Passed normally with no baseline-update environment variable, including all existing persistence/parser/cache/request-budget regressions and D3 post/discovery/pagination fixtures.

normalTypes.result: Passed; four existing Time.monotonic deprecation warnings. Subsequent localized label changes were compiled by the full fixture renderer and tested in both browsers.

apiOnlyTypes.result: Passed; four existing Time.monotonic deprecation warnings.

publicCommentJSON.HTML: Ten exact current HTML projection snapshots are intentional D3 UI changes; the public JSON hashes remain frozen.

visualInspection: Inspected discovery grids, mixed result rows, overflow-selected channel header/playlist cards, community/post attachments, no-JavaScript post, dark/RTL/enlarged rows, neutral hashtag art and AI replacements. Fixed inline cover geometry, fallback avatars, invisible watched progress, absent AI styling and incorrect filter/sort action labels. Approved D1 images remain unchanged.
limits: Local production-template fixtures with intercepted upstream/media and synthetic images; no live/deployed media or Android execution is claimed.
Embedded attachment content is stubbed in these thread fixtures; full embed-player checks remain D5/D7/D8.
D3 covers listing/navigation and community/post thread consumers. Full subscription/history/playlist workflows remain D4; watch/recommendation/Reddit/chat/enhancement editors retain D5/D6 owners.
Normal/API-only full linking and final cross-feature performance/retirement/audit remain D8/D9.
No remote deployment, production database use or new migration.
